en: Okay so this is occupancy of April, 89, 88. Our index MPI is 103, and our index of average rate is 109. So 103, 109, and then our RevPAR index is 113. So 17% higher. RevPAR number two. Actually was a really wonderful period.
zh: 好的，这是4月份的入住率，89%、88%。我们的市场渗透率指数（MPI）是103，平均房价指数是109。所以是103、109，然后我们的RevPAR（每间可售客房收入）指数是113。所以高出了17%。RevPAR排名第二。这确实是一段非常棒的时期。
clip_text: Okay so this is occupancy of April, 89, 88. Our index MPI is 103, and our index of average rate is 109. So 103, 109, and then our RevPAR index is 113. So 17% higher. RevPAR number two. Actually was a really wonderful period.

en: May so far also now, MPI 102, average 106, and then so far now RevPAR also 109, and ranking number three, which is on right track. Good thing is the ranking changes, now so far number two, which is higher than any other four hotels in this comp set.
zh: 5月到目前为止，MPI是102，平均房价指数是106，然后到目前为止RevPAR也是109，排名第三，正处于正确的轨道上。好消息是排名发生了变化，到目前为止排在第二位，这高于这个竞争群组中的其他四家酒店。
clip_text: May so far also now, MPI 102, average 106, and then so far now RevPAR also 109, and ranking number three, which is on right track. Good thing is the ranking changes, now so far number two, which is higher than any other four hotels in this comp set.

en: This is last year position. This is this year position. Last year position, we are here under a little bit of lower occupancy and lower average rate. Now a little bit higher on average rate and higher occupancy. But in the future we need to go this side to catch up this Peninsula. So we wanted to keep driving up to this track for the future.
zh: 这是去年的位置。这是今年的位置。去年的位置，我们在这里，入住率稍低，平均房价也较低。现在平均房价略高，入住率也更高。但在未来我们需要向这边走，去追赶半岛酒店。所以我们希望在未来继续沿着这条轨道向上提升。
clip_text: This is last year position. This is this year position. Last year position, we are here under a little bit of lower occupancy and lower average rate. Now a little bit higher on average rate and higher occupancy. But in the future we need to go this side to catch up this Peninsula. So we wanted to keep driving up to this track for the future.

en: Sales related, now contracted room night is similar to last year, which is on right track, but a little bit constraint on this only average rate though.
zh: 销售方面，目前的协议客房夜数与去年相似，这处于正确的轨道上，不过仅仅在平均房价上受到了一些限制。
clip_text: Sales related, now contracted room night is similar to last year, which is on right track, but a little bit constraint on this only average rate though.

en: Constraint our leisure segment, our CD team is doing great job on different kind of promotion joining. Keep having our average rate and occupancy higher up, which is also a great job. We are now doing the marketing team too.
zh: 尽管我们的休闲板块受限，我们的客户开发（CD）团队在参与各类促销活动方面做得很出色。不断将我们的平均房价和入住率拉高，这也是一项很棒的工作。我们现在的市场团队也在发力。
clip_text: Constraint our leisure segment, our CD team is doing great job on different kind of promotion joining. Keep having our average rate and occupancy higher up, which is also a great job. We are now doing the marketing team too.

en: Mo Li is a similar production as last year and this year, and we are expecting around 10% more from this Mo Li production. And also average rate is around 3,000 RMB, which is also good positioning as a long term.
zh: 茉莉（智慧）今年和去年的产量相似，我们预期茉莉的产量会有大约10%的增长。此外，平均房价在3000人民币左右，作为长期来看这也是一个很好的定位。
clip_text: Mo Li is a similar production as last year and this year, and we are expecting around 10% more from this Mo Li production. And also average rate is around 3,000 RMB, which is also good positioning as a long term.

en: GRC, I think it is good to see that only the average May we have GRC production is 1,800. Good balance on this last two weeks, especially this Sunday, Monday we also have a good group confirmed. So we are going to have driving our average rate and then also overall RGI this period to keep this our ranking and then RGI position.
zh: 团队客房（GRC）方面，我觉得很高兴看到仅仅在5月平均我们的团队产量就有1800。在过去两周保持了良好的平衡，特别是在这个周日、周一，我们也确认了一个优质的团队。因此，我们将在这一时期拉动我们的平均房价以及整体的收入生成指数（RGI），以保持我们的排名和RGI位置。
clip_text: GRC, I think it is good to see that only the average May we have GRC production is 1,800. Good balance on this last two weeks, especially this Sunday, Monday we also have a good group confirmed. So we are going to have driving our average rate and then also overall RGI this period to keep this our ranking and then RGI position.

en: June, our June total is 2,200. Especially we have a big Max Mara group. All the CEO, corporate team is coming fly from US to stay with us. We are now concentrating on this group to improve our overall F&B revenue as well. And then now there's room night 2,200 is well balanced on this June to keep our overall result achievement as well.
zh: 6月，我们6月份的总量是2200。特别是我们有一个大型的Max Mara团队。所有的首席执行官、公司高管团队都将从美国飞来入住我们酒店。我们现在正专注于这个团队，以期同时提高我们整体的餐饮收入。现在这2200个间夜在6月份分布得非常均衡，有助于我们保持整体的业绩达成。
clip_text: June, our June total is 2,200. Especially we have a big Max Mara group. All the CEO, corporate team is coming fly from US to stay with us. We are now concentrating on this group to improve our overall F&B revenue as well. And then now there's room night 2,200 is well balanced on this June to keep our overall result achievement as well.

en: May segment wise, last year same time comparison. Last year is 65%, 5,200 room night with average rate 2,404. But this year is a little bit 8% higher on the book, 5,800, 600 room night more. And then average rate also around 130 RMB higher. So position of the May is also well balanced. So now half, full year forecast we are now looking at that 97 million ahead, and half million, 85 million ahead. Sorry, this is wrong. But this is on the book, right? This one? Ah, this is different one. Forecast is 200 million versus budget is 178 million. So it's around 14 million ahead.
zh: 就5月份各细分市场而言，与去年同期相比。去年是65%的入住率，5200个间夜，平均房价2404。但今年账面预订量高出了大概8%，达到了5800，多了600个间夜。然后平均房价也高出了约130人民币。所以5月份的定位也是非常均衡的。所以现在，看全年的预测，我们现在看到超出了9700万，以及超出了8500万。抱歉，这个错了。但这（指着PPT）是账面数据，对吧？这个？啊，这是另一个数据。预测收入是2亿，而预算是1.78亿。所以大约超出了1400万。
clip_text: May segment wise, last year same time comparison. Last year is 65%, 5,200 room night with average rate 2,404. But this year is a little bit 8% higher on the book, 5,800, 600 room night more. And then average rate also around 130 RMB higher. So position of the May is also well balanced. So now half, full year forecast we are now looking at that 97 million ahead, and half million, 85 million ahead. Sorry, this is wrong. But this is on the book, right? This one? en: Just a few points is now we have this long-term average rate is 1,400. Last year 1,600. I think this one we may need to have a look into detail. And then corporate ADR is 1,400 to 1,500. So 1,500 means corporate lowest one among all of other segment. So corporate room night and overall average rate, which is higher than last year, we may need to relook into detail. Do we really need it or do we really need to shift other segment or not.
zh: 只有几点要提的是，现在我们的长住平均房价是1400。去年是1600。我认为这一点我们可能需要仔细研究一下。然后公司协议价（ADR）是1400到1500。所以1500意味着公司客户是所有其他细分市场中价格最低的。因此，面对比去年更高的公司间夜量和整体平均房价，我们可能需要重新深入研究细节。我们真的需要这类生意吗，或者我们到底需不需要将重心转移到其他细分市场。
clip_text: Just a few points is now we have this long-term average rate is 1,400. Last year 1,600. I think this one we may need to have a look into detail. And then corporate ADR is 1,400 to 1,500. So 1,500 means corporate lowest one among all of other segment. So corporate room night and overall average rate, which is higher than last year, we may need to relook into detail. Do we really need it or do we really need to shift other segment or not.
